description: This file defines the MdcEntry interface, representing a key-value pair for logging context (Mapped Diagnostic Context) within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes a static factory method for creating instances and accessor methods to retrieve the key and value.

classes.name: MdcEntry
classes.description: An interface representing a diagnostic context entry (key-value pair) used in logging frameworks to enrich log messages with contextual data.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an MdcEntry instance with the specified key and value, delegating to LoggingFactory.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key identifying the diagnostic context value.

methods.name: getValueOrNull
methods.description: Returns the diagnostic context value or null if not set.
